policy: Fixed parent low/high scales and calibration radii, with client interval gate; no retuning
population: Uniform sampling with replacement from exactly 842 parent test inputs plus 224 synthetic boundary inputs plus 256 shifted inputs, total 1322 rows; duplicate feature values, if any, retain their separate finite-population weights
independent_unit: One newly sampled population index plus independent new CKKS key/encryption randomness; one input per encrypted evaluation; no packed observations counted separately
outcomes: P(return a decision different from reference)
bound: Exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson; joint denominator all 600 requests; selective denominator all accepted requests; Bonferroni over 2 bounds
coverage: Report observed fraction; no coverage confidence claim
stopping: Exactly 600 requests; no early success or tuning; preserve failures and abstentions
claim_limits: Conditional on the frozen model, finite population, CKKS implementation, parameter policy and gate; randomized experiment uses a recorded pseudorandom input seed and OS crypto randomness. No clinical, Internet-traffic, unseen distribution, worst-case, model accuracy or malicious-server guarantee. Repeated source rows are intentional independent draws under this finite-population experiment, not new unique dataset rows.
